system.description:
Through a touch or a locked gaze you project the fearsome predator within, smothering the fire of a victim's emotions until only dull, apathetic submission remains.

Engage the victim in a Social Challenge (touching from surprise or by winning a Physical Challenge, or simply meeting their eyes — no words are needed). A defeated human or animal may use no Willpower Traits for the rest of the evening and gains the Negative Traits Submissive x2; repeated uses are not cumulative. To cow a vampire you must first expend a Willpower Trait before the challenge — success inflicts the same effects, or, used against a vampire in frenzy, snaps it back into lucidity instead of applying the other effects. You may not use this power on yourself. Retest with Animal Ken.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
